# ZiplineOS AI

> Connect AI assistants (Claude, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) to the ZiplineOS MCP server so they can build and safely edit ZiplineOS workflows and forms for Australian mortgage brokerages. Remote server, Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, scope mcp:workflows. Server URL: https://api.ziplineos.com.au/api/v1/mcp

The user must complete the ZiplineOS sign-in and consent themselves. Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT are not yet supported (coming soon).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): step-by-step instructions for an AI agent asked to set up ZiplineOS
- [README.md](README.md): overview, supported clients, data and control

## Skills (how to use the tools well)

- [build-a-workflow](plugins/ziplineos/skills/build-a-workflow/SKILL.md): build a new workflow, with forms first
- [edit-a-published-workflow](plugins/ziplineos/skills/edit-a-published-workflow/SKILL.md): edit the Release Candidate directly, hand over for publishing in ZiplineOS, edit forms in use
- [choose-scope-and-entries](plugins/ziplineos/skills/choose-scope-and-entries/SKILL.md): Shared or PerApplicant, single or multiple entries, repeating groups
- [build-a-module](plugins/ziplineos/skills/build-a-module/SKILL.md): modules (Subject items), optional groups of forms switched on or off per deal; defaultIncluded and the moduleAdded email
- [tag-questions-for-the-form-filler](plugins/ziplineos/skills/tag-questions-for-the-form-filler/SKILL.md): tag questions with data points so the Chrome extension fills Platform Plus and other websites
- [form-field-conventions](plugins/ziplineos/skills/form-field-conventions/SKILL.md): keys, types, order, visibility, configJson, PATCH edits
- [fact-find-patterns](plugins/ziplineos/skills/fact-find-patterns/SKILL.md): Australian mortgage fact-find shapes
- [build-a-calculation-engine](plugins/ziplineos/skills/build-a-calculation-engine/SKILL.md): build, test (`test_engine`, `test_integration`), validate and delete a Logic calculation engine (publishing is done in ZiplineOS)
- [set-up-branding-and-documents](plugins/ziplineos/skills/set-up-branding-and-documents/SKILL.md): set brand colour and logos, read logo advice, change AI document confidence and document categories (Owner or Admin)
- [Agent instructions (paste-in)](microsoft/agent-instructions.md): condensed rules for Copilot, ChatGPT and other assistants
